experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day speedboat tour from Krabi or Phuket visiting Phi Phi Don, Phi Phi Leh, Maya Bay, and Bamboo Island. Snorkel in crystal-clear turquoise waters, explore dramatic limestone cliffs, and relax on pristine white-sand beaches. Book the early morning departure to beat crowds and midday heat. On rainy days, opt for an indoor Thai cooking class in Ao Nang as an alternative.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Market Tour
experiences.description: Explore the legendary street food scene at Yaowarat (Chinatown) and the nearby Talat Noi neighborhood after sunset when temperatures drop. Sample pad kra pao, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, boat noodles, and fresh oyster omelets from local vendors. Join a guided walking food tour for insider access to hidden stalls and cultural context. This is naturally an evening activity, making it perfect for avoiding daytime heat.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunrise Kayaking & Mangrove Exploration
experiences.description: Paddle through serene mangrove forests and hidden sea caves along Koh Lanta's eastern coast at sunrise before the heat sets in. A local guide leads you through narrow channels teeming with wildlife including monitor lizards, kingfishers, and mudskippers. Finish with a stop at a floating fishing village for fresh coconut water. Indoor alternative: visit the Lanta Old Town cultural museum and traditional Chao Leh (Sea Gypsy) community center if weather turns.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar & Nimman Street Food Crawl
experiences.description: Spend an evening exploring the vibrant Chiang Mai Night Bazaar and the trendy Nimmanhaemin Road food scene. Taste northern Thai specialties including khao soi (coconut curry noodle soup), sai oua (herbed sausage), and nam prik noom (green chili dip) with fresh vegetables. Browse handcrafted goods and local art between bites. The cool northern evenings make this a comfortable and culturally rich experience. Rainy-day indoor alternative: visit the MAIIAM Contemporary Art Museum nearby.
experiences.location: Nimmanhaemin Road & Night Bazaar, Chiang Mai

experiences.name: Similan Islands Full-Day Snorkeling Expedition
experiences.description: Join a guided boat tour to the UNESCO-protected Similan Islands, renowned as one of the world's top snorkeling and diving destinations. Explore vibrant coral reefs, swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, and exotic tropical fish at multiple snorkeling sites. Relax on the powdery white sands of Donald Duck Bay during midday rest stops under shaded areas. Depart early from Khao Lak pier to maximize morning water clarity and cooler temperatures. Indoor alternative on closed-season or stormy days: visit the Khao Lak-Lam Ru National Park visitor center and mangrove boardwalk.
experiences.location: Similan Islands, Phang Nga Province (departing from Khao Lak)
